facts.text: The Palace Suites are located in the historical palace building and offer privacy for palace suite guests.
facts.excerpt: Located in the historical palace building, the elegant Palace Suites offer unmatched privacy only for the palace suite guests who seeks for extra privacy and exclusivity.

facts.text: The Sultan Suite in the historical palace has large sash windows, high ceilings and views of the Bosphorus, the historical peninsula, the palace courtyard or the park.
facts.excerpt: the Sultan Suite in the historical palace that offers a royal experience in line with local tradition, with large sash windows, high ceilings, and captivating views of the Bosphorus, the historical peninsula, the palace courtyard, or the park

facts.text: The hotel is in two buildings, a historical building and a modern hotel building, with a long Bosphorus shore between them; butlers provide a regular complimentary buggy transfer between the two.
facts.excerpt: As Çırağan Palace Kempinski dwells in two buildings, and there is a long Bosphorus shore between the historical building and the modern hotel building, regular complimentary buggy transfer services are provided by our butlers

facts.text: Custom-made furniture in the Palace Suites was inspired by Topkapi Palace, Dolmabahce Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace and Yildiz Palace.
facts.excerpt: Many custom-made furniture pieces were inspired by the Topkapı Palace, Dolmabahçe Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace and Yıldız Palace.

facts.text: Apart from the Sultan Suite, the Palace Suites are maisonette-style duplex suites.
facts.excerpt: Except for Sultan Suite, 10 of the Palace Suites are maisonette-style with featuring rich, custom-designed duplex suites

facts.text: Palace Suite guests receive handmade 100% pure olive oil soap in four scents: mint-lemon-green tea, jasmine, orange flower and rose-lavender.
facts.excerpt: Guests will enjoy 100% pure olive oil handmade soap, available in four different scents; mint-lemon-green tea, jasmine, orange flower, and rose-lavender.

facts.text: In the soap service the butler slices the soap for guests, giving one bar for immediate use and one wrapped in a pouch to take home.
facts.excerpt: marked by the butler slicing the soap for guests - one bar crafted for immediate use, another delicately wrapped in a pouch to take home

facts.text: The redesigned lobby has a high ceiling with a Murano-style grand chandelier and locally produced tile art.
facts.excerpt: The redesigned lobby features a high ceiling adorned with a Murano-style grand chandelier, locally produced tile art, and an elegant sitting area that exudes opulence.

facts.text: The lobby has large windows with a view of the Bosphorus Strait.
facts.excerpt: the large windows provide a stunning view of the Bosphorus Strait

facts.text: The hotel offers a guided history tour of the palace, narrated by a licensed professional tour guide.
facts.excerpt: narrated by a licensed professional tour guide

facts.text: The history tour is available only to guests staying at the hotel and requires pre-reservation through the Lady in Red team in Guest Relations.
facts.excerpt: To make a pre-reservation, please contact our Lady in Red team in the Guest Relations department.

facts.text: Every guest is welcomed by the Lady in Red, a host dressed in red with knowledge of the hotel and the local area.
facts.excerpt: every guest has been welcomed by our Lady in Red, providing thoughtful, individual and intuitive help and expertise.

facts.text: Palace Suite guests can enjoy complimentary amenities such as homemade baklavas and chocolates, Turkish delights, fresh fruits and nuts.
facts.excerpt: wide range of complimentary amenities, such as homemade baklavas and chocolates, Turkish delights, fresh fruits, nuts, and snacks

facts.text: Istanbul Airport is around 45 kilometers (28 miles) from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Distance from Istanbul Airport to the hotel is around 45 kilometers (28 miles).

facts.text: Sabiha Gokcen Airport is around 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Distance from Sabiha Gökçen Airport to the hotel is around 50 kilometers (31 miles).

facts.text: The Concierge team arranges private transfers to and from Istanbul Airport and Sabiha Gokcen International Airport.
facts.excerpt: seamless private transfer services to and from both Istanbul Airport and Sabiha Gökçen International Airport

facts.text: The hotel has Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star awards and is on the Condé Nast Traveler Gold List.
facts.excerpt: having received Five-Star awards from Forbes Travel Guide and listed in The Gold List of Condé Nast Traveler
